# SymbiYosys formal proofs for the CI `formal` job, installed with pip (YoWASP).
#
# The `yowasp-yosys` wheel bundles the whole Yosys/SymbiYosys stack: it provides
# `yowasp-sby`, `yowasp-yosys`, `yowasp-yosys-smtbmc` and
# `yowasp-yosys-witness` (there is no separate `yowasp-sby` package).  `z3-solver`
# provides the `z3` binary that the `smtbmc` engine runs.
#
# Used by actions/setup-python as the cache key (cache: pip).
yowasp-yosys==0.70.0.0.post1259
z3-solver==5.3.1.0
